findings.finding: Fixed actual config SHA/commit/episode/roots, complete predecessor REQUEST/ACK/ACK_VERIFIED chain, exact root operational binding, original supervisor identity including parent, and STATUS advanced beyond selected barrier are mandatory. No ACK is created or replaced.

Only ordered accepted part-NNNN.tar.gz readbacks in OPS/root_archive_io/<exact stage>/readback are candidates; matching originals remain in OPS/durable/<exact stage>. Exact plan SHA, fixed stage population, independent single-link regular inodes, symlink rejection and captured parent dirfd restrict every unlink.

Matches frozen archive_io actual complete upload results, materialize ToolResponse, ordered transfer identity/version, helper argv/stdin/cwd, actual external_step successful WAIT4, exact stdout/stderr descriptors and returned output path. Unknown or partial outcomes stop. Helper names/hashes match current restored helpers.

Prepare re-enters unchanged original verify_ack against currently existing payloads, then source and duplicate full SHA/stat/xattrs are verified; execute rechecks all and protects small stage/root/helper evidence byte/stat population. Retained originals receive full SHA/xattr re-verification after retirement. RAW/CAS/scientific source and remote objects are outside mutation scope.

Original absolute 12-hour window, initial OOM baseline, original supervisor parent/PID/start_ticks/group/session and immutable start policy are checked throughout. Full visible /proc FD/maps PASS is required. Only typed unknown coverage with zero target references can settle for <=10 seconds, every <=0.2 seconds with fsynced evidence and continuing health; known references/unrelated exceptions fail immediately. This is not mutation retry.

Exclusive stage/execution paths and nonblocking flock reject repeats. Intent is fsynced before a single dirfd unlink; return, parent fsync and absence receive separate records. Any exception stops; missing final receipt or journal ambiguity explicitly requires reconciliation and cannot be treated as success or retried automatically.

When actual primary and outer terminal receipts exist, the candidate extracts the exact frozen metadata-only detached_provenance function with all names it needs. Original wait4_launcher child_identity and START_POLICY supervisor_identity both use integer proc_identity. Departed supervisor liveness is replaced by exact matching successful primary/outer/detached ancestry, not by a synthetic exit.

Frozen supervisor verifies each ACK once before recording ACK_VERIFIED; subsequent stages and final_closure retain previous metadata and coverage. Literal finalization operates on RAW/CAS. Postseal checks all 17 REQUEST/ACK/ACK_VERIFIED/manifest chains without reopening retired readback part payloads. Later manual original verify_ack would require real remote rematerialization to independent paths, which the plan/result explicitly state.

limitations: Independent static/config/source review is not a production prepare, deletion result, or fresh remote-service authentication.
/proc is a complete observation snapshot, not a continuous kernel lease; final identity/xattr/dirfd checks narrow but cannot eliminate concurrent external filesystem mutation.

A failure after unlink but before a success journal can leave known_unlinks_returned shorter than actual removed paths; the fsynced last intent and fresh path/inode observation must be reconciled. No retry is authorized by this review.
COMPLETE appearing before outer/detached terminal receipts close causes a truthful temporary failure; root should start terminal retirement only after all actual terminal receipts exist.
All reads retain the physical reserve; >16 MiB metadata or unexpected concurrently changing small evidence fails closed instead of broadening the scope.
POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED is advisory; no memory or future capacity qualification is inferred.
review_scope: Read entire candidate script, compare frozen consumer/helper schemas and actual immutable configuration/source pins; no candidate import/execution and no scientific result decoding.
